items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: It doesn't matter, Mr. Pirot Billet (PHONETIC).

ctx.x: So by St. Germaine being such a rich municipality, they were going to make it a national conservatory. So what does the director do, after being -- I was there five years, and he was saying, "Oh, Kenny, your work is so beautiful. I love you." If you could see the letter he wrote me after all that. Then they decided they were going to get rid of jazz or they wouldn't be made national. So they scratched jazz off, and he wrote me a letter. He says listen, I'm sorry, but we have to drop your program, and blah, blah,…
